summary: Iteration 48 — RevenueCat 'any active entitlement = Premium' live-bug fix. BACKEND (pytest, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration48_revenuecat_entitlement.py — 15/15 passed in 13.3s, JUnit: /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iteration48.xml). POST /api/membership/entitlement verified end-to-end: (a) {active:true, entitlement_id:'Aureve', expires_at:null, app_user_id:'user_testaura01'} returns premium:true, updated:true, premium_source:'revenuecat' and premium_until ~50y out (asserted > now+40y); subsequent GET /api/auth/me shows premium:true, premium_source:'revenuecat'. (b) With expires_at='2027-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' the server stores that exact ISO (equality check after parse) and GET /auth/me still premium:true. (c) With expires_at='2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' the server stores the past date BUT GET /auth/me returns premium:false — endpoint does not pretend the user is premium (is_premium() checks premium_until > now). (d) Grant-only semantics confirmed: {active:false} returns updated:false and leaves an existing premium_until untouched; posting an earlier expires_at than the stored date never shortens it (stored date wins). (e) Auth required (POST with no bearer → 401). (f) app_user_id in the body is advisory only — posting a different app_user_id while authenticated as user_testaura01 only updates that account; a second account (review@aureve.app, logged in separately) is byte-identical before and after. (g) Premium grant actually unlocks gated AI features — /tryon (feature 'tryon', not in FREE_LIMITS, strictly Premium) returns 402 pre-grant and 400 (missing person_image, i.e. past the gate) post-grant. WEBHOOK: INITIAL_PURCHASE with no expiration_at_ms now stores far-future premium_until (>40y, not 31d); TEMPORARY_ENTITLEMENT_GRANT with no expiry stores ~31d (29-32d window asserted); EXPIRATION with no expiry clears premium_until to null → premium:false; CANCELLATION with past expiration_at_ms also clears to null; event id de-duplication works — posting the same event id twice (with a clear in between) does NOT re-grant. REGRESSION: /auth/me still has premium:bool; /membership/trial behaves (200/400/403 depending on flag/state, no crash). FRONTEND (web smoke @ 390x844, reviewer login review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable>): app boots, login works, /premium renders ('You are on Premium. Active until 1/1/2099' banner + plans card), /profile shows 'Premium' badge + 'Aureve Reviewer' + manage-subscription testID (count=1) with Renew/2099 text visible. 0 serious console errors from the new AuthContext wiring (syncEntitlement, AppState 'active' listener, addCustomerInfoListener stub) — the web purchases stub returns {active:false,...} and syncEntitlement short-circuits without posting to the backend, exactly as designed. No red screen. Test account restored to premium (premium_until=2099-01-01, premium_source=revenuecat via webhook) by the pytest teardown fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:930-988 — POST /membership/entitlement correctly: short-circuits on active:false (returns {updated:false, premium:is_premium(account)}); defaults a non-expiring entitlement to now+50y; honours an explicit expires_at verbatim (incl. past dates); max()es against the existing premium_until so an earlier incoming date never shrinks the stored one; ONLY updates account['user_id'] from the bearer — payload.app_user_id is persisted on the user doc for diagnostics but never used as the update key, so a hostile client cannot grant premium to another account.

server.py:1036-1057 — webhook: when expiration_at_ms is absent and the event type is in _RC_ACTIVE_TYPES, until_dt is now+50y for every lifetime/promotional/non-renewing/initial case EXCEPT TEMPORARY_ENTITLEMENT_GRANT which stays at now+31d. EXPIRATION/CANCELLATION with past-or-absent expiry resolve to active=False → premium_until:null, which clears the entitlement.
server.py:1026-1030 — event id dedup inserts into db.revenuecat_events and returns early on duplicate, preventing re-grants from retried deliveries.

src/context/AuthContext.tsx:270-309 — syncEntitlement reads CustomerInfo via refreshCustomerInfo(), only POSTs to /membership/entitlement when state.active is true, then re-hydrates /auth/me. initPurchases(uid) is memoised per user id so it only runs once per sign-in; the AppState 'active' listener and addCustomerInfoListener are correctly cleaned up on unmount. On web the purchases stub makes all these no-ops (0 console errors).

src/services/purchases.ts (web stub) returns entitlementState active:false, refreshCustomerInfo:null, addCustomerInfoListener as a no-op unsubscriber — syncEntitlement therefore never POSTs on web, which is exactly what we want.

success_rate.frontend: 100% web smoke — login + /premium render + /profile premium state + 0 serious console errors from new AuthContext wiring. Native RevenueCat flow (actual purchase, CustomerInfo refresh on launch/foreground, listener re-sync) is NOT testable in the web preview and must be verified on a device build (per the review-request note).

seed_data_creation: None persisted beyond fixtures. Each test fixture (autouse) teardown re-grants premium to user_testaura01 (premium_until=2099-01-01, premium_source=revenuecat) via a webhook event so subsequent suites see the same state the credentials file documents. A handful of TEST_iter48_* and testsetup_/testclear_ event ids were inserted into db.revenuecat_events — harmless; they only ever cause future duplicates to be ignored. No wardrobe items, outfits, or wear logs were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RevenueCat entitlement wiring is fully covered server-side. Key endpoints: POST /api/membership/entitlement {active, entitlement_id, expires_at?, product_id?, app_user_id?} — Bearer-authenticated, only ever updates the authenticated user; non-expiring entitlement → premium_until ≈ now+50y; past expires_at is stored verbatim (so premium:false), inactive is a no-op, earlier dates never shrink the stored expiry. Webhook POST /api/webhooks/revenuecat: INITIAL_PURCHASE/RENEWAL/UNCANCELLATION/PRODUCT_CHANGE/NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE/SUBSCRIPTION_EXTENDED without expiration_at_ms → +50y; TEMPORARY_ENTITLEMENT_GRANT → +31d; EXPIRATION/CANCELLATION with past/absent expiry → premium_until null; dedup by event.id via db.revenuecat_events. Frontend web stub (/app/frontend/src/services/purchases.ts) deliberately makes refreshCustomerInfo/entitlementState/addCustomerInfoListener no-ops so the AuthContext wiring is safe to call on web — the real purchases.native.ts path requires a device build to exercise. Reviewer login (review@aureve.app / <set via the REVIEWER_PASSWORD environment variable>) remains premium with premium_until=2099 (seeded on backend startup via seed_reviewer_account). Pytest account user_testaura01 (bearer <set via the TEST_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable>) was left premium via the autouse teardown.
rca_of_issue: RCA already captured in the problem statement (the client gated on EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT='premium' while the live entitlement is 'Aureve'; backend only wrote premium_until from the webhook so a non-expiring/missed event left it null forever). The fix — any active entitlement unlocks + client posts entitlement to the new endpoint + webhook defaults non-expiring events to +50y except TEMPORARY_ENTITLEMENT_GRANT — is correct and fully verified by the 15 pytest cases above.
